page_title: AdGuard Ad Blocker — block ads, popups, and trackers

summary.name: AdGuard
summary.one_liner: AdGuard is a family of ad-blocking and privacy products, including apps for Windows, Mac, Android, iOS, and Linux plus free browser extensions, that block ads, trackers, and malicious sites.
use_cases: block ads and pop-ups in browsers
block ads inside apps on Android or iOS
stop websites and companies tracking browsing
protect against phishing and malicious sites
ad blocking on Mac and Safari
summary.what_it_does: The page lists AdGuard products for Windows, Mac, Android, iOS, Android TV, and Linux, along with browser extensions, AdGuard Home, VPN, DNS, Mail, and Temp Mail. It says the ad blocker removes banners, pop-ups, and video ads (including on YouTube), blocks analytics and online trackers, and protects against phishing and malicious sites. The full apps for Windows, Mac, and Android offer a free trial, and the Android and iOS apps have limited free versions. The FAQ says a license is needed for multi-device use and for advanced features such as in-app ad blocking and DNS protection.
notable: Blocks ads system-wide and inside apps on Android and iOS, not just in browsers
Free browser extensions plus full apps with a trial
Includes AdGuard Home (network-level DNS blocking) and DNS, VPN, Mail, and Temp Mail products
Company says it has developed privacy products since 2009 and has over 160 million users
caveats: Full functionality (in-app blocking, DNS protection, firewall, multi-device use) requires a paid license; free versions are limited
Free versions on Android and iOS have reduced features
Desktop apps for Windows and Mac are offered with a free trial only
